meta_title: draft() — Say it. Get your story.
meta_desc: A private AI that turns your messy spoken words into a finished, shareable story. You talk — draft() shapes it into something people actually read. Your words stay yours: never sold, never used to train.
hero_sub: You talk. draft() shapes it into something people actually read.
demo_raw: so um… the bakery was closing… lights half off… and the owner just let me in? gave me the last croissant… yeah. good day I guess
demo_clean: The bakery was closing when I got there — but the owner saw me through the glass, unlocked the door, and handed me the last croissant. Some days the city is kinder than you expect.
prob_h2: You had a whole day. Then you opened the caption box and… nothing.
prob_lede: You're not a bad storyteller. You just started at the hardest part — the blank page. The story was already in you. It just needed a way out.
how1_p: Rambling is fine. Half-sentences are fine. Say it however it comes.
how2_h: draft() asks a few questions to find the real moment.
how2_p: Two or three gentle prompts — the ones a good editor would ask.
how3_h: Get a finished story — hook to close — ready to post.
how3_p: Structured, readable, and yours. The gold moment.
tf_lede: This is what thirty messy seconds becomes.
tf_raw: so um today I went to that bakery… the one near the station? and it was basically closed, like lights half off… and the owner just… I don't know… he let me in anyway? and gave me the last croissant and I just… yeah. it was a good day I guess
tf_s1: The bakery lights were already half off when I got there.
tf_s2: I almost turned back — then the owner saw me through the glass, unlocked the door without a word, and handed me the last croissant on the tray.
tf_s3: I keep thinking about that small, unearned kindness. Some days the city is softer than you expect. Today was one of them.
cr_lede: One tap reshapes your story for where you post it — length, tone, and line breaks included.
priv_lede: The messy version, the honest version, the 11pm version — they stay yours. You decide what's kept and what's shared; nothing is ever sold or used to train.
priv1: Your words are yours — never sold, never used to train.
priv2: You decide what's kept, and what's deleted.
priv3: Only the finished story is shared — when you choose to.
